fact: Several non-sentient gelatinous cubes emerge from the rocks in the Traders' Grotto.
source_quote: several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks
subject: Traders' Grotto

fact: The gelatinous cubes are non-sentient creatures that ooze out of the rocks.
source_quote: several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks
subject: gelatinous cubes

fact: Glabbagool is blamed by gnomes for the arrival of the gelatinous cubes.
source_quote: some pointed accusingly at Glabbagool
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool denies being one of the attackers.
source_quote: tried to explain that he was not one of the attackers
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool describes the attacking cubes as 'mindless, silly creatures'.
source_quote: He dismissed the hostile cubes as “mindless, silly creatures”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool claims the mindless cubes give intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name.
source_quote: giving intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool advises the party to use acid protection if available.
source_quote: to use acid protection if they had it
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool advises pulling out trapped party members quickly.
source_quote: to pull out anyone who became trapped as quickly as possible
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Zalthir strikes a gelatinous cube with two powerful blows.
source_quote: Zalthir rushed forward, struck one cube with two powerful blows
subject: Zalthir first strike

fact: Zalthir retreats before a gelatinous cube's pseudopod can hit him.
source_quote: dashed back before its pseudopod could hit him
subject: Zalthir retreat

fact: Thorin throws darts at the gelatinous cubes while keeping his distance.
source_quote: Thorin kept his distance and hurled darts
subject: Thorin darts

fact: Gyrgum channels Divine Spark as necrotic force.
source_quote: Gyrgum raised his holy symbol and channeled Divine Spark as necrotic force
subject: Gyrgum Divine Spark

fact: The gelatinous cubes engulf gnome merchants.
source_quote: engulfing gnome merchants
subject: gelatinous cubes

fact: Some gnome victims struggle free from the gelatinous cubes.
source_quote: Some victims managed to struggle free
subject: gnome escape

fact: A gnome dies and begins dissolving inside a gelatinous cube.

subject: dead gnome

fact: Glabbagool moves toward the battle to prove he is on 'team sentience'.
source_quote: Glabbagool began making his way toward the battle to demonstrate that he was firmly on “team sentience.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Daz places a Fireball among the gelatinous cubes.
source_quote: Daz carefully placed a Fireball among the cubes
subject: Daz Fireball 1

fact: One gelatinous cube partially avoids the first Fireball.

fact: Most gelatinous cubes take the full force of the first Fireball.

subject: gelatinous cubes

fact: Zalthir activates his Eldritch Claw Tattoo, causing tentacle-like extensions to grow from his hands.
source_quote: Zalthir then activated his Eldritch Claw Tattoo, causing tentacle-like extensions to grow from his hands
subject: Zalthir Eldritch Claw Tattoo

fact: Glabbagool asks Zalthir if he is an ooze.
source_quote: Glabbagool exclaimed, “You've got pseudopods too,” and sincerely asked whether Zalthir was an ooze
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Zalthir answers that he is an 'aspiring ooze'.
source_quote: Zalthir answered, “No, no, just an aspiring ooze. Let's say that”
subject: Zalthir

fact: Thorin moves closer to throw darts at the gelatinous cubes.
source_quote: Thorin moved closer to keep throwing darts
subject: Thorin darts 2

fact: Dawnbringer questions Thorin's combat performance.

subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Gyrgum strikes again with Divine Spark.

subject: Gyrgum Divine Spark 2

fact: Daz positions a second Fireball to catch the remaining cubes without hitting allies.

source_quote: The blast dissolved one cube

fact: Zalthir finishes the last gelatinous cube with his eldritch claw from afar.
source_quote: Zalthir casually finished it from afar with his eldritch claw
subject: Zalthir kill

fact: The last gelatinous cube is killed by Zalthir.
source_quote: Zalthir casually finished it from afar with his eldritch claw
subject: last gelatinous cube

source_quote: Thorin complained, “Damn it. Let me have this.”
